findings.claim: Contractless mode serializes only public read-write members. For fields, IsPublicReadWrite requires field.IsReadOnly, so it keeps only readonly fields and excludes normal mutable public fields. The doc comment says public read-write fields are serialized, so this looks like an inverted condition. Ordinary public fields would be silently omitted from the wire format.
